title: Remove slider controls and convert ServiceCarousel to static stacked cards

requirements.summary: Remove all navigation controls from ServiceCarousel including the circular arrow button, pagination dots, and slide counter text
acceptanceCriteria: No circular arrow button is visible on the page
No '1 / 8' or any slide counter text is visible

file_operations.description: Remove the circular up/down arrow navigation button, pagination dots indicator, and the '1 / 8' counter text from the component's JSX. Delete all associated state variables, event handlers, and CSS classes related to these navigation elements.

requirements.summary: Convert ServiceCarousel from a swipeable carousel to a simple vertically stacked list without any slider functionality
acceptanceCriteria: All service category cards are rendered in a single vertically stacked layout with no carousel wrapper
Page scrolls smoothly through the cards without snapping or jumping
No touch/swipe gesture handling interferes with normal page scroll
No overflow:hidden or scroll-snap CSS is applied to the cards container

file_operations.description: Remove all carousel/slider logic: eliminate touch/swipe event handlers (onTouchStart, onTouchMove, onTouchEnd, onMouseDown, onMouseMove, onMouseUp), remove scroll-snap CSS properties, remove overflow:hidden styles, and delete any state tracking for active slide index. Replace the carousel container with a simple flex column layout that displays all service category cards in a vertically stacked format with normal block flow. Preserve all card content and onClick navigation handlers.

requirements.summary: Preserve the exact visual appearance of each service category card including images, titles, descriptions, links, design, colors, fonts, and spacing
acceptanceCriteria: Each card displays its image, title, description, and 'View Services' link identical to the previous design
Card spacing, colors, and fonts are visually unchanged from the version before slider removal

file_operations.description: Ensure all existing card styling (background colors, shadows, border radius, hover effects, transitions), card content (service category images using fallback cycling logic, titles, descriptions, 'View Services' link text), typography (font families, sizes, weights), and spacing (gaps, padding, margins) remain completely unchanged. Only modify the container layout structure while keeping individual card JSX and styling identical.
